description: This file defines a dataset mapper class for the DETR object detection model, including functions for building data transformations and processing dataset entries, with specific handling for image augmentation, cropping, and annotation transformation.

classes.name: DetrDatasetMapper
classes.description: A dataset mapper class that converts dataset entries into a format suitable for DETR, applying transformations, cropping, and annotation processing.

methods.name: build_transform_gen
methods.description: Creates a list of data transformation generators based on configuration and training mode.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the dataset mapper with configuration, setting up cropping, transformations, and image format.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Processes a dataset dictionary: reads image, applies transformations, cropping, converts to tensor, and processes annotations.
